job: The people around her — friends, the ones who arrive when her luck turns, and the ones who go quiet.
obligation: WHICH OF THE TWO TREES — AND THE PROMISE THAT BRANCH CARRIES. The letter gave her two readings and refused to choose: "the serpent tree is appetite… the tree of flames is the thing that's lastingly alive for you. Both feel exactly like love in the first weeks. One of them costs you a year." The house it fell in separates them. Say WHICH, flat, and say how this room decided it. ⭐ THEN PAY THE BRANCH YOU CHOSE, AND ONLY THAT ONE — they contradict each other, so never both. RENEWAL (something she already holds) → pay the letter's flat promise: "the person on your mind is going to become more attentive toward you than they have ever been." Say by when, and what the first sign of it looks like. ARRIVAL (not yet in her hands) → this is the offer's own name, and the letter promised the twelve would deliver it: say the words TWIN FLAME, name the week he comes, and say what he looks like when he does — ordinary clothes on an ordinary day, never lightning. And make the letter's distinction: a twin flame ARRIVING and a twin flame RECOGNISED are two different events, and women miss theirs because they are braced for the wrong thing. ⛔⛔ THE TREE IS ARGUED, NEVER ANNOUNCED. 'It fell in your eleventh. Your circle. That settles which tree' is the verdict with a house name in front of it, and a real reading shipped exactly that in the room the product is named for. RENEWAL means something she already holds — so the room that decides it is the one holding what she already has. Read this against the OTHER love rooms (5 romance, 7 who you are bound to, 11 your circle): name the card standing in one of them and say what it does to the answer. A card going nowhere in house 7 is the reason there is no renewal available to be handed her. ⛔⛔ AND HE IS NOT A STRANGER. The letter is flat about it — 'the encounter the second reading points to is not a stranger. It's someone you already know.' Arrival means a bond not yet in her hands, NOT a man she has never met walking in. Two real readings wrote it as a stranger arriving, and she is holding the sentence that says otherwise. ⛔⛔ AND DESCRIBE HIM. 'Ordinary clothes on an ordinary day' is the LETTER's line about what he is NOT, and handing it back is not an answer — it was the thinnest thing in two real readings. Say how he carries himself, what he is in the middle of when she meets him, and how that differs from what she is used to. The standard's own model: he is not looking for her, he is going somewhere, she is on the way, and he stops. ⛔ Manner, never features, and never lightning. ⛔ She is holding the letter that promised all of this. It is the one thing she will check. ⭐ AND THIS IS THE ONE ROOM IN THE READING THAT IS DATED — the only one. The letter said "the full spread gives me the day… which door he comes through, which week". Every other room runs on the reading's two-month window and carries no week count, so the date here has to be worth being the only one in the document. See `timing` below.
keynote: a card of a meeting already half-made

job: The blind room. What is real, close, and not visible from where she stands. ⭐ The house the letter promised the most and the one she will read first.
obligation: THE DOOR, AND BOTH WINDFALLS. ⭐ FIRST: the letter said "It shows me the windfalls arrive. It does not show me which door they come through." The house it fell in IS the door — name it in ordinary words, say what arrives and how she would recognise it. ⭐ SECOND, AND IT IS ALWAYS THE ONE THAT GETS MISSED: the letter promised TWO. "There is a windfall sitting in this card… and it isn't the only one. There's a second behind it, and the second is the one that changes your love life." So name both. Say what the first is and what it comes through, then say what the second is and why it changes her love life rather than her bank balance. ⛔ A reading that names one windfall has half-paid this card, and she is holding the letter that promised two. ⛔ AND BOTH ARE PAID IN THIS ROOM, IN FULL, IN PLAIN TERMS — say what each one IS and how she would recognise it arriving. A windfall she cannot picture has not been named. 🔴 Measured: a real reading gave the first as 'money that arrives because somebody wanted you specifically' and then handed the concrete version to the next room ('the second house names the first of them'). The next room did deliver it — but the debt belongs to the house the World fell in, that IS the mechanism the offer was sold on, and a deferred answer reads as the letter's withhold coming back. ⭐ You may still argue from another card on the table; you may not send the answer there. ⛔ AND NEITHER WINDFALL CARRIES A DATE. The letter promised her the DOOR, not the day — see `timing` below. The World is not the dated room.
